s1.desc: a breakfast kitchen drawn on a plain pale grey background

s2.desc: a sunny outdoor farmers market, at a stall under a striped cream and yellow awning stacked with jars of jam

s3.desc: a living room drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.view: with a shiny turquoise counter in front holding two little penguin-face mugs, a croissant on a plate and jars, and a round table with wooden chairs behind them

beats.text: Pax pours coffee from a French press into a mug on the counter while Polly lifts a waffle from her baking tray with a spatula
Pax sets the French press down on the counter and stands smiling while Polly places waffles on the plates on the table behind him
Pax raises a red and white spray can and shakes it beside his face, eyes shut and grinning, while Polly holds up her spatula

spans.notes: Pax stands behind the counter (lower body hidden by it). The two mugs on the counter have penguin faces (one in Pax's colours, one in Polly's): small props, not drawn as characters; kept, but flagged to the lead as a possible lead_copy call. | Lead review 2026-10-26: dropped - two penguin-face mugs in Pax's and Polly's colours are recognisable depictions of the leads (same rule as Intentional's face mugs).

spans.view: with pots of lavender and leafy trees behind the stall and snowy ground in front

beats.text: Polly nibbles a slice of jam bread, closing her eyes as she chews, while Pax stands beside her holding paper grocery bags and little hearts drift up
Polly holds the jam bread out toward Pax and smiles with her eyes shut while he eyes it and a small heart floats up
Pax leans over and takes a bite of the jam bread from Polly's flipper
Pax straightens up and chews with wide eyes while Polly watches him and a small heart floats up above him
Pax smiles with his eyes closed and his beak open while Polly beams back at him with her eyes shut

props: paper bags of bread and vegetables
spans.notes: verification pass 2 (verify2_report_0): beat 152-188 says Pax nods with his eyes closed and a delighted smile for the whole range; f152-168 his eyes are open (wide, chewing, looking up) and they close only from f169-170; Polly's eyes also close from f168; beat 116-138: Polly holds the bread out at her side from f114 and smiles with her eyes closed f123-130 while a heart floats up (not described)

spans.view: with a cream sofa behind Pax and a round window high on the wall

beats.text: Pax sweeps a small pile of dust toward a dustpan with his broom while Polly wipes the round window behind him with a yellow cloth
Polly waves at Pax through the round window while Pax stops sweeping and looks up at her
Polly raises a flipper to her beak and blows Pax a kiss through the window
Polly waves as a small red heart pops up beside her while Pax blinks up at her
Pax blushes with rosy cheeks and a bashful grin, a flipper on his chest, while Polly keeps waving and smiling

spans.notes: Polly is outside, seen through the round window (head and chest only).
